experiment: Expert-wise activation calibration MVP (diagnostic; not a replacement for fixed-budget E3)
expert_rule: L16 candidate-pool routed-token counts (rows 0-1999, runs_allocation_minimal/routing_profile_v2.npz, Profiler routing, model top-k); ascending sort (ties -> lower id); ranks round(i*59/7), i=0..7

test.note: historical E3 test rows (never used for selection or references)

conditions.SR: one uniform random set of 128 sequences shared by all experts
conditions.SC: one set minimizing mean_e D_e(S) (seeded stochastic greedy + best-improvement swaps)
conditions.EC: per expert, S_e minimizing D_e(S_e) (same optimizer)
conditions.ER: per expert, an independent uniform random set of 128

objective: D_e(S) = 1/2 sum_{p in gu,down} ||H_ep(S) - H_ep^pool||_F / (||H_ep^pool||_F + eps), 64-d Gaussian sketches z = R_p^T x (N(0,1/64), fixed seed), H token-normalized; empty-token -> H(S) := 0
optimizer: stochastic greedy (each step: argmin over a seeded uniform 10% sample of remaining candidates), then swap passes visiting slots in seeded order, best out-of-set replacement scored in closed form, accepted only if the exact objective decreases (rel tol 1e-9); <= 5 passes
rng_streams: SeedSequence([seed, cond]) for SR/SC, ([seed, cond, e]) for EC/ER, ([seed, 7919, cond, e]) for token matching
token_matching: k_e = min over SR/SC/EC/ER of routed-token count; per condition choose exactly k_e of the (seq, dispatch-row) pairs uniformly without replacement; the same row indices address the gate/up input and the down input (alignment checked bitwise every sequence)
gptq: moe_calib.gptq.quantize_expert unchanged: 4-bit, g128, act-order, percdamp 1.0; H = sum x x^T fp32
metric: moe_calib.quant_eval.per_seq_rel_errors (E3 definition, gate+up+down), mean over held-out sequences, 128 routed tokens/seq cap (Profiler default); summary = mean over the 8 experts

decision_rule.paired_improvement: r_e(X over Y) = (err_Y - err_X) / err_Y per expert; seed-level = mean over 8 experts
decision_rule.consistent: seed-level r > 0 in all 3 seeds AND seed-averaged r_e > 0 for >= 6/8 experts
decision_rule.primary: EC vs SC (constraint relaxation under the covariance surrogate)
secondary: ER vs SR (constraint relaxation with random selection: independence / noise reference)

secondary_analysis: UNMATCHED: the same four selections quantized with ALL routed tokens (token quantity not controlled); reported separately, never mixed with the primary matched result
